title: Body Diagram 18 Points
versionOrder: Within each capture, save order is retained. Cross-capture ordering is a presentation guess; tape numbers do not establish development dates. Similarity clusters are provisional, and collected saves are not necessarily revisions of one program.

versions.label: Body/joint data and graphics, 18 points
versions.note: validated payload; runtime untested. Ordered lines; consistent pointer base 22204; exact full length and end marker; byte-identical left/right recovery
versions.unavailableReason: The source refers to extensions, external cassette data, machine code, or functions unavailable in the stock player.
versions.startupSource:
10 CLS
15 P=1
20 BP=18
30 DIM B$(BP),A(BP),X(BP),Y(BP),C(BP,3),P(BP),N(BP)
40 FOR X=1TOBP: READ B$(X): NEXT X
50 FOR Z=1TO4:READ Z(Z):NEXTZ
60 DATA RIGHT TOE,RIGHT ANKEL, RIGHT KNEE,RIGHT HOP,LEFT HIP,LEFT KNEE,LEFT ANKLE,LEFT SHOULDER,LEFT ELBOW, LEFT HAND,RIGHT SHOULDER,RIGHT ALBOW,RIGHT HAND,CHEST,NECK,RIGHT EAR,LEFT EAR,LEFT TOE,0,1,0,-1
70 FORX=1TOBP:READ C(X,2),C(X,3):C(X,1)=C(X,3):C(X,2)=C(X,2)/2:NEXT
80 C(16,1)=60:C(17,1)=60
100 A$=INKEY$:IFA$=""THEN120ELSEIFA$="E"THEN P=13ELSEIFA$="R" THEN THEN P=14ELSEIFA$="T"THEN P=15ELSEIFA$="Q"THEN P=11ELSEIFA$="W"THENP=12ELSEIFA$="0"THENP=10ELSEIFVAL(A$)<>0THENP=VAL(A$)
120 PRINT@960,B$(P);"             ";
130 IF A$=" "THEN Z=Z+1:IFZ>4THENZ=1
controlSource: 100 A$=INKEY$:IFA$=""THEN120ELSEIFA$="E"THEN P=13ELSEIFA$="R" THEN THEN P=14ELSEIFA$="T"THEN P=15ELSEIFA$="Q"THEN P=11ELSEIFA$="W"THENP=12ELSEIFA$="0"THENP=10ELSEIFVAL(A$)<>0THENP=VAL(A$)
